The combination of downhill sections, winding roads, variable spring weather, and late-course hills makes it one of the more challenging and unpredictable majors. The course begins with a fast downhill from Hopkinton, climbs gently through suburban towns, reaches a rowdy peak at Newton’s hills, and finishes with energy-charged crowds pouring into Boston’s heart.
